citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 2:30 PM on 13
August, 2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee/registrant by calling curator and discussed availability for
inspection. Today 3 employees are out (unexpected medical/jury duty and planned leave), and therefore the assistant
manager and zookeepers are not available for inspection, especially later in the day. Failure to provide access to the
facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations.
End Section
